title: Explicit Decay Rate and Quantitative Threshold for the SND Gronwall Inequality: T2 Conditional Closure and GNC–Goldbach Bridge
desc:
We prove that the T2 inter-shell flux dispersal inequality closes conditionally on the Spectral Non-Dispersal (SND) condition, with explicit decay rate α = 2ν²·4^(1/ρ₀)·ρ₀ derived from the Shell-Spread Poincaré Inequality.

Key results:
(1) Lemma 1: The low-frequency inter-shell flux vanishes exactly by incompressibility — unconditional, no approximation.
(2) Lemma 2: Under SND and the H^2.3 absorbing ball, |Φ_j(t)| ≤ C_φ·2^(-0.8j)·X(t)^(1/2)·D(t)^(1/2) with exponential shell decay.
